<!-- pr-reviewer: 94027109c7a5fef250bb200218d1850f0b3f401b -->
Blocker: SKILL.md step 4 re-labels an issue whose claimant commented `unclaim`, so it flaps on every 10-minute tick.

**Blocker - unclaim does not stick (SKILL.md step 4, Add vs Withdraw)**
- Withdraw removes `claimed` when the claimant later comments `unclaim`, but their original `claimed:` / `/claim` comment is still there.
- On the next tick the Add query (7-day window) finds that comment again. "Already mirrored" needs `claimed` to be set, and Withdraw just removed it, so the comment falls through to **otherwise**: the label and assignee come back and another "Claim recorded" reply is posted. The tick after that withdraws it again. The result is a label flip plus two bot comments every 10 minutes until the comment leaves the 7-day window.
- Fix: Add must skip a claim comment from `<login>` when that same login commented `unclaim` (or `/unclaim`) on the issue after it. The same check belongs in AGENTS.md "Check before claiming", so an issue picker does not treat that comment as a live claim either.

**What checks out**
- Files: only `AGENTS.md`, `.claude/skills/review-prs/SKILL.md` and `docs/decisions/comment-claims.md` change.
- `gh pr view 281 --json mergeable` returns MERGEABLE.
- The Add snippet is valid. I ran it read-only, exactly as written, against the live repo: exit 0, 37 `<N> <login> <time>` lines (for example `215 bherbruck` and `215 mkinney`, which the "held by someone else" case handles). No `/unclaim` false positive: `test("^ *(claimed:|/claim)")` is false for `/unclaim`.
- Withdraw leaves a hand-set label alone: it only fires when a "Claim recorded" reply exists and the claim comment is gone, so a label with no claim and no reply stays. Agent (`NeoTech`) claims are left to the 4 h rule.
- The AGENTS.md section covers each part of the instruction: check before claiming, mirror, withdraw on deletion, and the comment stands with no timer.

**Nits (non-blocking)**
1. AGENTS.md "Claim before any code" still says, without qualification, that a `claimed` issue is stale when its last claim comment is older than 4 h. The new bullet says the 4 h rule is "for agent claims only", but an agent reading "Claim before any code" first could reclaim a contributor's issue. Add "(agent claims; a contributor's comment claim does not go stale - see below)" there.
2. "Pick" filters only `-label:claimed`, so an issue claimed by comment alone still shows up in the pick list. "Check before claiming" catches it, but one clause in Pick pointing to that check would help.
3. The regex is anchored to the start of the body (jq `^` without the `x`/multiline flag), so a `claimed:` on the second line of a comment is not matched, although both texts say "a line that starts". I tested it: `"hello\nclaimed: me"` gives false. Either say "a comment that starts with" or match per line (`split("\n") | any(test(...))`).
4. Add only looks back 7 days, but a contributor's claim "stands while the comment exists". An older claim that was never labelled is only caught by the pick-time check, which is fine but worth one sentence in step 4.
5. Withdraw edge case: if a collaborator hand-labels an issue for someone else after a contributor's claim there was recorded and later deleted or unclaimed, Withdraw will drop the hand-set label. This is rare; a note is enough.

<!-- pr-reviewer: db7455d83d6b662a87409317b152cad3a781c506 -->
Clean - ready to merge

I re-reviewed head db7455d against my previous review (94027109). I only read the repo; nothing was pushed, labelled or edited.

**The blocker is fixed.** SKILL.md step 4 now has a **withdrawn** bullet, listed first: it skips a claim comment when `<login>` commented `unclaim` or `/unclaim` after `<time>`. Walking through it:
- Withdraw removes the label.
- On the next tick, Add sees the old comment but skips it as withdrawn. The label stays off and no new reply is posted.
- If the contributor claims again later, the new claim comes after their `unclaim`, so it is mirrored normally.

AGENTS.md "Check before claiming" now has the same exception, so the two files agree.

**Nits 1-3 are fixed:**
- "Claim before any code": the 4 h stale rule now applies to agent claims only.
- "Pick" now drops issues whose comments hold a live contributor claim.
- The pattern now matches a claim at the start of any line. I tested it with jq: `"hello\nclaimed: me"` and `"x\n  /claim"` match; `"/unclaim"` and `"I unclaimed: x"` do not.

**Checks:**
- Files: only `AGENTS.md`, `.claude/skills/review-prs/SKILL.md` and `docs/decisions/comment-claims.md` change.
- `gh pr view 281 --json mergeable` returns MERGEABLE.
- I copied the step 4 snippet byte-for-byte from the head commit and ran it read-only against the live repo: exit 0, 37 `<N> <login> <time>` lines.

Leaving nits 4 and 5 as they are is fine. The check before claiming covers older claims that never got a label, and the hand-label edge case is rare.

**Nit (non-blocking):** the newline in the jq pattern is a literal line break inside the quoted jq string. It works, but an editor or a copy-paste that reflows or trims the line would break it silently. `test("(^|\n) *(claimed:|/claim)"; "i")` does the same thing on one line.
